summary: Implemented resolution events. Final advisory gate passed 1,211 tests with 900 changed lines. Sealed Plan unchanged; all three prior findings addressed.

evidence: src/eval_lab/resolutions.py implements L10 prediction compatibility, evidence eligibility, sampling requirements and immutable resolution events.
Changes remain within the planned runtime, private integrations, documentation, new tests and step report.
tests/test_resolutions.py::test_literal_elimination_overlap_identical_and_residual verifies literal statuses, ordering and residual retention.
test_prerequisite_rejections_do_not_append and test_stopping_declarations_are_attributed_and_exact reject drafts, disallowed evidence, insufficient arms and invalid human declarations.
test_raw_frozen_defaults_rejected_at_each_read_boundary rejects five default-field deletions during preparation and transactional admission, with zero appended event/reference rows.
test_direct_admission_rejects_altered_application_timestamp covers initial and successor events; test_timestamp_receipt_is_bound_to_prepared_content detects receipt reuse.
src/eval_lab/persistence.py:44 shares raw retained-plan verification across ordinary and transactional reads.
test_cli_show_schema_reopen_snapshots_and_public_boundaries verifies private CLI/schema integration, complete snapshot histories, cross-clip dependencies and reopened replay.
test_scoped_plan_links_and_context_corrections_do_not_rewrite_replay and test_transaction_checks_live_context_after_preparation verify exact context and transaction-time revalidation.
Final advisory attempt 2 passed 1,211 product tests, frozen harness tests and approval checks; git diff --check passed.
Input-validator mutations are detected by test_exact_inputs, test_evidence_pin_guards, test_direct_nested_copy_extras_are_revalidated and test_prerequisite_rejections_do_not_append.
History-validator mutations are detected by test_initial_predecessor_guard_is_not_collision and test_correction_guards_have_no_revision_collision, including preparation separately from admission.

Sampling and stopping mutations are detected by test_duplicate_sample_units_cannot_inflate_counts, test_instrument_lineage_revisions_and_link_aliases_count_once, test_stopping_declarations_are_attributed_and_exact and test_fixed_design_rejects_stopping_declaration.

Admission/replay mutations are detected by test_direct_repository_rederives_computed_fields, test_direct_admission_rejects_altered_application_timestamp, test_timestamp_receipt_is_bound_to_prepared_content and test_replay_rejects_changed_dependency_digest_and_computed_states.

test_raw_frozen_defaults_rejected_at_each_read_boundary detects independently bypassed raw checks and removed payload-type validation. Mutation details and tests-first failures are recorded in loop/reports/STEP-0018-L10.md.
docs/hypothesis-testing.md and resolve/show/snapshot/export help document the implemented behavior.
Fresh tests reproduced ten raw-default corruption bypasses before the fix and a receipt-content bypass before complete-event binding.
test_associated_resolutions_are_private_in_each_presentation_state establishes actual case-intent association; deliberate disclosure fails public/embed tests in both blind and revealed states.
test_determinism_survives_enumeration_and_later_hypothesis_plan_revisions verifies bounded reproducibility. The report records actual versions and seven verified file hashes.
Documentation distinguishes human declarations, local issuance integrity and software validation from empirical validity or authenticated chronology.
Final G7 reports 900 changed lines against the 900-line ceiling.
G4-G6 and G10 report no existing-test removals, protected changes, forbidden paths or dependency changes; G11 confirms the sealed Plan matches.
No deferred functionality, network access, real-clip judgments or Git history/branch/remote mutations were performed.
